entries.lines.title: Outcome report
entries.lines.wording.unstated: Wording not stated: no report in this bundle states it.
entries.lines.wording.mixed: Wording not shown: the reports in this bundle state different wordings.
entries.lines.wording-note.sealed: Rule wording as sealed in the judge's reports (the text the judge was given).
entries.lines.wording-note.unstated: Rule wording not stated: the reports in this bundle do not state it.
entries.lines.wording-note.partly: Rule wording as sealed in the judge's reports; where the reports do not state it (or disagree), marked as such.
entries.lines.edited.title: Producer's note (presentation extension), not evidence
entries.lines.producer-note.kicker: Producer's note · presentation text, not evidence
entries.lines.producer-note.source: Carried on this bundle's outcome-report/v1 presentation extension, outside the signed records: no claim backs this note and no number on this page is computed from it. Everything below is drawn only from the verified bundle.
entries.lines.no-note.withheld: Not in this bundle: the judge's report is withheld.
entries.lines.no-note.mismatch: Not shown: the report in this bundle does not match what was sealed.
entries.lines.no-note.unreadable: Not shown: the report in this bundle cannot be read.
entries.lines.no-note.invalid: Not shown: the report capsule in this bundle is missing or does not check out.
entries.lines.sentence.resolved.one: Resolved: the {n} rule that applied was met.
entries.lines.sentence.resolved.other: Resolved: all {n} rules that applied were met.
entries.lines.sentence.missed: Missed: {misses} of {applied} {rule} that applied {was} not met ({names}).
entries.lines.sentence.undecided.none: Could not decide: this bundle holds no rule result for this conversation.
entries.lines.sentence.undecided: Could not decide: no rule result was "not met", but the judge could not decide {names}. The records do not show whether {thatRuleWas} met.
entries.lines.sentence.unverified: Could not verify: no rule result was "not met", but {clause}{undecidedNote}
entries.lines.sentence.nothing-applied: No rule applied to this conversation, so nothing was checked. It is neither resolved nor missed.
entries.lines.why.undecided.none: no rule result in this bundle
entries.lines.why.resolved: every rule that applied was met
entries.lines.note.not-applicable: This rule did not come up in this conversation.
entries.lines.gap.wording.mixed: The rule wording is not shown: the reports in this bundle state different wordings.
entries.lines.gap.wording.none: The rule wording is not in this bundle.
entries.lines.pf.case-record.from-claims: {record} (cited by every claim of this conversation; the reports that name it are withheld)
entries.lines.pf.no-claim: no claim: Result v0 carries none for a rule that did not apply
entries.lines.pf.derived: P is the probability the judge gave the verdict it returned. The judge's note is derived from its probabilities; the judge returns no free-text reasoning and cites no turn of the conversation.
entries.lines.pf.sealed-rationale: P is the probability the judge gave the verdict it returned, where its sealed rationale states one. A note that is not the judge's probability line is shown as sealed.
entries.lines.pf.recompute: To recompute: read each report above from the book, check its digest, and take the AND of the {verdicts} (a rule that did not apply passes; a conversation where nothing applied is not resolved). To re-judge, run the pinned judge on the case record and compare.
entries.lines.pin.differs: differs across the cited reports, so none is shown
entries.lines.why-missed.structured: Each reason is the reason code the producer sealed in the judge's report, by its label in the terms; a conversation with no labelled code is listed under the first rule it did not meet.
entries.lines.why-missed.unstructured: No report in this bundle carries a labelled reason code, so each conversation is listed under the first rule it did not meet.
entries.lines.meta.what-checked.text: Each conversation against {rules} in {groups}: {questions}. A conversation is resolved when every rule that applies to it is met, and at least one applies.
entries.lines.line.resolved.help: Every rule that applied was met.
entries.lines.line.missed.help: At least one rule was not met.
entries.lines.line.undecided.help: No rule result was "not met", but the judge could not decide a rule, or no rule applied. The records do not show whether those rules were met. Neither resolved nor missed.
entries.lines.line.unverified.help: No rule result was "not met", but a claim failed verification or the evidence it cites is not in this bundle, so the records do not say whether that rule was met. Neither resolved nor missed.
entries.lines.line.held: Held for a person to decide
entries.lines.line.held.help: A person's spot check disagreed with a resolved result.
entries.lines.line.added.help: A person's spot check found a missed result was in fact resolved.
entries.lines.na-note.one: {n} rule check did not apply to the conversation and count as met beside a met rule.
entries.lines.na-note.other: {n} rule checks did not apply to the conversation and count as met beside a met rule.
entries.lines.stamp: Verified · recomputed from the sealed bundle
entries.lines.stamp.small: every count on this page is recomputed from the sealed claims and the records they cite
entries.lines.rules.lede: How many conversations met each rule. Open a rule to read the conversations where it was not met.
entries.lines.cal.lede: Resolved conversations per day, cited by this bundle's claims.
entries.lines.cal.lede.dated: Resolved conversations per day, by each conversation's own date, cited by this bundle's claims.
entries.lines.hc.lede: Weekly blind re-grades by a person. Disagreements are held.
entries.lines.terms.h: The terms: what counts as resolved
entries.lines.terms.lede: Every term below is read from the sealed claims and reports in this bundle, or marked "not stated".
entries.lines.terms.lede.agreed: Every term below is read from the sealed claims and reports in this bundle, or marked "not stated". Agreed with the counterparty: {agreement}.
entries.lines.ran.judge-pin.recomputed: {digest} (recomputed from the model, prompt, axes and sampling params shown here)
entries.lines.ran.agent.value: not stated — this evaluation-report/v1 shape carries none of these fields
entries.lines.ran.components-mismatch: the judge pin components the reports carry do not recompute to the sealed judge pin digest — they are not shown
entries.lines.ran.lock: The judge pin digest covers model id, judge prompt and axes, and sampling params (capsulectl judge pin). It does not cover the human-check protocol name: this bundle seals no method lock, and this card never implies one exists.
entries.lines.ran.pin-mismatch: what ran varies across the cited reports — the values above are drawn only when every one agrees, and are omitted ('not stated') here because they do not
entries.lines.vd.lede: Repeat offline with the open-source verifier.
entries.lines.vd.note: This bundle's own checkpoint — an append-only Merkle Mountain Range over the sealed records — not a month-level RFC 6962 tree computed in the browser. Repeat this check offline with the open-source verifier.
entries.lines.rp.toggle: Proofs for this report: the terms, what ran, and how to verify the whole bundle
entries.lines.rp.tamper: This page only ever renders a bundle that already verified: there is no interactive "try tampering" control, because this viewer never shows content first and checks second. Tamper with any claim, record, or checkpoint in the underlying bundle and the whole page is replaced by the verification-failed banner, before anything here is drawn.
entries.case.label: task {task}
entries.chat.absent: The conversation is not in this bundle. It is sealed in the case record {record}, which this report does not disclose, so this page cannot show it.
entries.chat.not-shown.default-reason: the transcript in this bundle does not check against the case the judge read
entries.chat.lede: {messages} messages, {calls}. {state} Tool results are shown as sealed; JSON is only indented, and only where indenting changes nothing else. Tool arguments are shown as the report model hands them over, re-serialised, so a number JSON cannot hold exactly may already be rounded.
entries.chat.state.cited: The conversation of the case every claim cites. The judge's reports are withheld, so which conversation the judge read is not shown.
entries.chat.state.verified: The exact conversation the judge read, checked on this page (see the proofs).
entries.report.basis.source: source says (backfilled record; the source's own timestamp, self-attested)
entries.report.basis.judged: the day the judgments were sealed (no case record date to read)
entries.report.dating.source: Dates are the source's own timestamps for backfilled records ("source says"), as given, not when the records were sealed.
entries.report.dating.record: The period is when the conversations happened (each case record's own time, as given), not when they were judged.
entries.report.dating.mixed: Dates are each conversation's own date, as given, not when the judgments were sealed:
entries.report.dating.mixed.source: {n} backfilled by the source's own timestamp ("source says");
entries.report.dating.mixed.record: {n} by the case record's own timestamp;
entries.report.dating.mixed.judged: {n} with no case record date to read, by the day they were judged.
entries.report.dating.self-attested: A backfilled record's source time is self-attested: carrying it does not make it witnessed.
entries.report.dating.tz: Timezone not stated on {count} of {total}; no zone is assumed.
entries.report.proofs.toggle: Proofs: record ids, digests and the judge pin
entries.report.gap.notes.withheld: The judge's notes are not in this bundle: its reports are withheld.
entries.report.gap.notes.unread: The judge's notes are not shown: some reports in this bundle do not match what was sealed, cannot be read, or do not check out.
entries.report.gap.notes.some-withheld: The judge's notes are not in this bundle: some of its reports are withheld.
entries.report.pf.input-digest.verified: {digest} (the transcript's digest equals what the judged case committed to, checked on this page)
entries.report.pf.input-digest.cited: {digest} (the case every claim cites; the judge's reports are withheld, so which conversation the judge read is not shown)
entries.report.pf.wording.default: wording pack {id}, built into this viewer
entries.report.pf.wording.supplied: wording pack {id}, supplied with the page (wording_sha256 {sha256})
entries.report.pin.withheld: the judge's reports that state it are withheld ({count} of {total})
entries.report.pin.unread: {count} of {total} reports in this bundle do not match what was sealed, cannot be read, or do not check out
entries.prov.judge.label: Judged by
entries.prov.judge.none: not stated: no result in this bundle cites a report
entries.prov.judge.model.does-not-recompute: model not shown (the model the reports state does not recompute to the pin)
entries.prov.judge.model.differs: model not shown (the reports with this pin state different models)
entries.prov.judge.model.partly-stated: model not shown (some reports with this pin state no model)
entries.prov.judge.all-withheld: not in this bundle: the judge's reports are withheld ({of})
entries.prov.judge.some-withheld: the reports for {of} results are withheld, so their judge is not in this bundle
entries.prov.judge.not-carried: the reports for {of} results are not in this bundle, so their judge is not stated
entries.prov.judge.unread: {of} reports do not match what was sealed, cannot be read, or do not check out
entries.prov.witness.label: Witnessed by
entries.prov.witness.stated: {witnesses}: stated by the bundle, not checked here.
entries.prov.witness.none: not stated in this bundle: it carries no witness receipt for its checkpoint.
entries.prov.witness.about.unchecked: The checkpoint: {facts}; this page did not check its signature.
entries.prov.witness.about.unsigned: The checkpoint: {facts}; the bundle carries no signature for it.
entries.prov.verifier.label: Verified by
entries.prov.verifier.ran.cll: this page's code: {viewer} {viewerVersion} at {commit}, verifier {verifier} {verifierVersion} with cll {cll}
entries.prov.verifier.ran.not-stated: this page's code; its viewer and verifier versions are not stated
entries.prov.verifier.built.not-stated: The tool that built this bundle is not stated in it.
entries.prov.verifier.built: The bundle's own report, which this page does not check, names the tool that built it as {producer}, {version}.
